National Dementia Workforce Study

Nursing Homes

Weighted outcomes and uncertainty

The dot is the weighted estimate; the line is its approximate 95% confidence interval. Orange marks n = 30–49. Suppressed estimates stay withheld.

Workforce composition

Current credentials, shown for the selected facility group. Role shares are withheld together if any role has fewer than 30 valid respondents. Another facility group may also be withheld so a hidden value cannot be recovered by subtraction.

Methods

  • Each wave uses its own FinalWeight. No pooling.
  • Approximate 95% intervals use facility clusters; strata and finite population corrections are omitted.
  • Facility groups are bed-size and rural groupings, not geography; there are no NH state or region estimates.
  • Estimates with valid n < 30 are withheld; n = 30–49 is flagged. Waves are separate samples, not change within people.
  • Satisfaction wording differs by wave: Wave 1 middle options are “Dissatisfied” and “Satisfied”, Wave 2 are “Somewhat dissatisfied” and “Somewhat satisfied”. Compare waves with caution.
  • No model is fitted and no map is drawn for NH.
